title: Telemetry Pipeline with Schema Evolution
summary: A fleet of deployed clients streams telemetry events into a pipeline that buffers, deduplicates, and stores them raw and curated for dashboards, ad hoc queries, and alerting under field-level access control; a schema registry and canonical-name mapping table fold already-deployed old clients' inconsistent telemetry_name variants into one metric without losing history or merging unrelated ones.
